paragraphs.text: Mint Budgie desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-mint-budgie

Mint Budgie is a desktop-only pet for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It floats above
other windows, shows t

he current project and activity only while the agent is
working, and does not render a second pet in
side the dsh window.
English | 简体中文
## Features

- Drag the pet across every monitor on the Windows virtual desktop.
- Release a drag to let the pet

fall naturally. A quick flick throws it with
bounded velocity, gravity, wall bounce, floor friction

and a short
bottom-anchored landing squash.
- The task bubble temporarily hides while the pet is air

borne, then returns
after the pet settles.
- While idle, the pet plays a random gesture every 30–75

seconds using a
randomized delay and avoids repeating the same gesture consecutively.
- Single-click

plays one random gesture: head tilt, head stretch, spread
wings or side-wing wave. Every gesture st

arts and ends in the standing pose.
- Gesture frames normalize the apparent head scale while allowin

g each pose
to keep its own position and perspective.
- Both the pet and task bubble detect per-moni

tor work areas, shift away
from screen edges and never straddle a dual-monitor boundary.
- Double-cl

ick opens or hides the dsh window. If an active task bubble is
minimized, the same double-click rest

ores it.
- Right-click for settings or to hide the pet.
- Size and opacity support sliders, numeric

input and reset; both persist.
- The Codex-style task bubble stays fixed at 284x65 and scrolls long

activity
text horizontally. Idle shows no bubble and no "idle" label.
- Every sprite frame is aligne

d to one shared foot line, so the pet rests
directly on the work-area floor without clipping low fra

mes.
- Wing gestures use the complete supplied source drawing. The generator never
cuts out or rotat
es individual wings, so faces and torsos stay intact.
## Development plan

The physical drag/throw roadmap, status interactions and size-reduction plan
are documented in docs/

DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.zh.md
(Chinese).
## Status mapping
| Source signal | Pet row | Label |

| any agent is `running` or the session has an open turn | `running` | Running |
| `approval/request

` open | `waiting` | Waiting |
| `agent/error` within 4 s | `failed` | Failed |
| otherwise | `idle`

ing` | Waiting |
| `agent/error` within 4 s | `failed` | Failed |
| otherwise | `idle` | no bubble |

`Agent.status` itself is only `idle | running`; the waiting and failed rows come
from the two transi
ent Host events above.
## Architecture

The dsh Host writes `desktop/state.json`; `desktop/pet-window.pyw` polls it and
renders the desktop

window with tkinter + Pillow. The Host may start the pet,
but the pet process survives a Host restar

t. `desktop/setup-startup.ps1` can
also install a login shortcut that launches the pet independently

. `desktop/setup-startup.ps1` can
also install a login shortcut that launches the pet independently.

The process uses a per-monitor DPI-aware context so mixed-scale monitors keep
consistent sprite and

window coordinates. The pet seeds the user's AppData
settings from `desktop/default-settings.json`;

the right-click settings panel
writes to the per-user copy so plugin upgrades do not overwrite prefe

ht-click settings panel
writes to the per-user copy so plugin upgrades do not overwrite preferences.

The launcher prefers the newest packaged `desktop/mint-budgie-<version>.exe`,
so Windows users do no

t need Python and upgrades can coexist with a currently
running pet. If no executable is available,

Pillow and tkinter are required and
Python is resolved from `DSH_PET_PYTHON`, then `pyw.exe`, `pytho

nw.exe`, `py.exe`,
and `python.exe` on `PATH`.

From the DSH plugin market, search for `dsh-mint-budgie` and install it, then

## Files

- `index.js` - Host state polling, persistence and desktop-process bridge
- `client.js` - compatibil

ity shim; intentionally registers no in-window pet
- `desktop/pet-window.pyw` - standalone desktop o

verlay
- `desktop/pet_physics.py` - dependency-free drag, throw, collision and landing physics
- `as

sets/spritesheet.png` - working/status sheet read by the desktop overlay
- `assets/poses/head-tilt_<
frame>.png` - aligned click gesture frames
## Disabling

Remove `dsh-mint-budgie` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in the active profile's
`package.json`, then res

sh-mint-budgie` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in the active profile's
`package.json`, then restart dsh.
